_readme: Voice pack settings. Voice ids are not secrets and are safe to commit; API keys are NOT stored here (use .env). Find voices with: node tools/voice-gen.js voices --gender female --accent indian --lang hi  and audition them with: node tools/voice-gen.js audition

azure._note: Azure Neural voices (e.g. en-IN-NeerjaNeural, hi-IN-SwaraNeural). Styles are emulated with speaking rate, pitch and volume only.

voices._note: A string works for both languages; use {"en": "...", "hi": "..."} for different voices per language. Missing characters borrow from: ELSPETH<-NARRATOR, THOMAS<-ELSPETH, ROWAN/JOSIAH/DR. VENN<-DACRE, MARGARET<-NARRATOR. NARRATOR and DACRE are required.

styles._note: stability: creative (most emotional range) | natural | robust (most even). style: 0..1 exaggeration. speed: 0.7..1.2. tag: an audio tag for Eleven v3/v4 (ignored for other models). Edit these after listening to the audition clips. azure.* are used only with the azure provider.
